entries.title: Living coded Atlas v4 baseline
entries.reason: This is the real shipped baseline and must remain reachable until DS2 verdicts and DS4 consumer migrations prove each replacement.
rejected_alternatives: Delete or bypass v4 immediately in favor of the newer archive; this would remove a verified live consumer before a replacement capability chain exists.
Keep v4 permanently canonical; this would preserve the v4/v15 ownership fork and block the governed package migration.
entries.revisit_condition: DS2 has item-level counterpart verdicts and DS4 has an admitted package, migrated consumers, browser/accessibility evidence, and a legacy-path strangle record.
entries.sunset_condition: The live v4 default path is removed or guarded only after every affected consumer resolves through an admitted DS4 replacement.

next_adjudication.completion_signal: Every in-scope live counterpart has a DS2 verdict and every admitted replacement has a DS4 migration disposition.

not_yet: This source-level verdict does not adjudicate an individual v4 component or token.
No package or consumer is changed by DS0.

claiming all v4 components are stable

entries.title: Atlas v4 design and adoption documents
entries.reason: The documents preserve dated v4 rationale and ADR-linked deltas but no longer own current Atlas law or execution.
rejected_alternatives: Delete the v4 records; this would erase intentional delta and ADR history needed for safe DS2/DS4 migration.
Leave them canonical beside the surface constitution and DS0 record; this would retain P06 ownership ambiguity.
entries.revisit_condition: DS2 and DS4 have consumed every retained v4 rationale and a durable replacement reference makes the historical records archive-ready.
entries.sunset_condition: They may move to historical docs after DS4 closes the v4 migration, but ADR-047 remains until superseded through the ADR process.

next_adjudication.completion_signal: Each retained v4 decision is preserved, replaced, or escalated through the correct ADR/adoption process.

not_yet: Supersession does not reverse accepted ADR-047.
The historical local download path is not replayable evidence.

authoritative_for: historical v4 rationale and deliberate deltas

entries.title: Atlas v7 product, marketing, and client surfaces plan
entries.reason: The v7 plan contains useful trust, publication, and accountability material, but Revision 2 owns execution and constitutional gates.
rejected_alternatives: Continue executing the v7 ten-wave roadmap in parallel; its topology and public gates predate the current authority program.
Archive it immediately; DS11-DS13 would lose a bounded material source before task-plan triage.
entries.revisit_condition: DS11, DS12, and DS13 task plans have incorporated or explicitly rejected every retained material item.
entries.sunset_condition: Archive the v7 plan after DS11-DS13 material triage closes; never reactivate it as an execution master.

next_adjudication.completion_signal: Each retained v7 item is linked to a current task-plan deliverable or explicitly rejected with rationale.

entries.title: Atlas v15 best-in-class readiness archive
entries.reason: The sha256-pinned archive is a rich candidate source but lacks PolicyOS consumers, browser/manual-AT evidence, authority compatibility, and package admission.
rejected_alternatives: Promote all v15 contents because archive reports say PASS or stable; those labels prove archive structure, not the PolicyOS capability chain.
Reject the archive wholesale because it is external; this would discard useful candidate substance before item-level conformance.
entries.revisit_condition: DS2 has an item-level verdict for every in-scope token set, component, pattern, mode, governance asset, i18n/Figma asset, and product-flow artifact.
entries.sunset_condition: Retain the immutable archive as provenance after adjudication; sunset only its candidate-source role when every item has a durable verdict and evidence path.

governance, i18n, Figma, content, security/privacy UX, and product patterns
